# Uğur Dindar / PortfoCLI

> Uğur Dindar is a software engineer at Garanti BBVA Technology, building secure payment systems and event-driven applications with Java, Spring Boot, and Apache Kafka. He serves as a division-level Kafka subject matter expert, contributes to an AI-assisted software security initiative, and builds reusable AI agent tooling. PortfoCLI is his multilingual portfolio.

The portfolio is available in English, Turkish, and German. Its profile, experience, and skills combine the English résumé with professional updates supplied by Uğur. Shared AI agent tooling and the team's Claude-based digital worker are separate parts of his development workflow.
